title: What If Humans Could Live to 150?

scenes.text: What if humans could live to 150? Science says the real limit may sit right there.
The oldest person on record, Jeanne Calment, lived to 122.
A study in Nature Communications measured resilience, how quickly the body recovers from stress.
Recovery slows with age, and the study says it would be lost entirely at around 120 to 150 years.
Researchers at Gero in Singapore and Roswell Park in New York put the absolute limit near 150.
Even with perfect medicine, the study argues, our ability to recover would eventually run out.
